title: Sayyid al-Istighfar (Master Supplication for Forgiveness)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana abduka, wa ana ala ahdika wa wadika mastatatu, audhu bika min sharri ma sanatu, abuu laka binimatika alayya, wa abuu bidhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta.
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sins except You.
virtueOrContext: Whoever recites this with conviction in the morning or evening and passes away that day or night enters Paradise.

title: Protection in Allah's Perfect Words
arabicText: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
transliteration: Audhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
virtueOrContext: Recite three times in the evening or when stopping at any place for protection from harm.

title: Contentment with Allah, Islam, and the Prophet
arabicText: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
transliteration: Raditu billahi rabba, wa bil-Islami dina, wa bi-Muhammadin sallallahu alayhi wa sallama nabiyya.
translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) as my Prophet.
virtueOrContext: Recite three times in the morning and three times in the evening.

title: Protection Against Sudden Harm
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru maasmihi shayun fil-ardi wa la fis-samai wa huwas-Samiul-Alim.
translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
virtueOrContext: Recite three times in the morning and evening to be safeguarded from sudden affliction.

title: Morning Remembrance of Sovereignty
arabicText: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir.
translation: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner; to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
virtueOrContext: Core morning supplication acknowledging Allah's dominion and asking for the good of the day.

title: Evening Remembrance of Sovereignty
arabicText: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir.
translation: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner; to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
virtueOrContext: Recited in the evening to place the night under Allah's care and mercy.

title: Entering Morning by Allah's Leave
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur.
translation: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our resurrection.
virtueOrContext: Recited every morning after Fajr.

title: Entering Evening by Allah's Leave
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu wa ilaykal-masir.
translation: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our return.
virtueOrContext: Recited every evening after Asr or Maghrib.

title: Asking for Well-Being in Faith and Life
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
transliteration: Allahumma inni asalukal-afwa wal-afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah, Allahumma inni asalukal-afwa wal-afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali.
translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth.
virtueOrContext: The Prophet never left reciting this supplication every morning and evening.

title: Affirming the Natural Disposition of Islam
arabicText: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
transliteration: Asbahna ala fitratil-Islam, wa ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa ala dini nabiyyina Muhammadin sallallahu alayhi wa sallam.
translation: We rise upon the natural religion of Islam, the word of pure devotion, and the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him).
virtueOrContext: Recited in the morning to renew devotion and pure monotheism.

title: Sufficiency of Allah in All Affairs
arabicText: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul-arshil-azim.
translation: Allah is sufficient for me; none has the right to be worshipped except Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
virtueOrContext: Recited seven times morning and evening to entrust all worries to Allah.

title: Seeking Useful Knowledge and Accepted Deeds
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
transliteration: Allahumma inni asaluka ilman nafian, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa amalan mutaqabbala.
translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, goodly provision, and deeds that are accepted.
virtueOrContext: Recited every morning immediately after the Dawn (Fajr) prayer.

title: Glorifying Allah with Praise
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsihi, wa zinata arshihi, wa midada kalimatih.
translation: Glory be to Allah and praise Him, by the number of His creation, His own pleasure, the weight of His Throne, and the ink of His words.
virtueOrContext: Recite three times in the morning; surpasses hours of continuous remembrance in weight.

title: Dua Before Going to Sleep
arabicText: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.
translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
virtueOrContext: Recited every night when lying down to sleep.

title: Dua Immediately Upon Waking Up
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana bada ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.
translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the resurrection.
virtueOrContext: First words spoken upon waking up from sleep.

title: Protection from Punishment on Resurrection Day
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
transliteration: Allahumma qini adhabaka yawma tabathu ibadak.
translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
virtueOrContext: Recited three times while resting on the right side with the hand beneath the cheek.

title: Entrusting One's Soul to Allah Before Sleep
arabicText: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
transliteration: Bismika rabbi wadatu janbi, wa bika arfauhu, fa in amsakta nafsi farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi ibadakas-salihin.
translation: In Your name, my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise. If You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.
virtueOrContext: Recited after dusting the bed before lying down to sleep.

title: Surrendering Heart and Face to Allah
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ
transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa aljatu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk.
translation: O Allah, I submit my soul unto You, entrust my affair unto You, turn my face unto You, and depend wholly upon You, in hope and fear of You.
virtueOrContext: Recited after performing ablution before sleep.

title: Praise for Food, Drink, and Shelter
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مُؤْوِيَ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi atamana wa saqana, wa kafana, wa awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wa la muwi.
translation: All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink, sufficed us, and sheltered us; how many are those who have no one to suffice them or give them shelter.
virtueOrContext: Recited when settling into bed at night.

title: Waking Up in the Middle of the Night
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir. Subhanallah, walhamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone without partner; to Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things capable. Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, none is worthy of worship except Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power nor strength except through Allah.
virtueOrContext: Whoever says this when turning over in sleep at night and then supplicates or prays will have their prayer answered.

title: Seeking Refuge When Frightened in Sleep
arabicText: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
transliteration: Audhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min ghadabihi wa iqabihi, wa sharri ibadihi, wa min hamazatish-shayatini wa an yahdurun.
translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, from the evil of His servants, and from the whispers of the devils and their presence.
virtueOrContext: Recited when startled or experiencing nightmares during sleep.

title: Ayat al-Kursi Before Sleeping
arabicText: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la takhudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard...
translation: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth...
virtueOrContext: A guardian angel from Allah remains over the reciter until morning.

title: Last Two Verses of Surah Al-Baqarah
arabicText: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
transliteration: Amanar-Rasulu bima unzila ilayhi mir-Rabbihi wal-muminun, kullun amana billahi wa malaikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih...
translation: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers...
virtueOrContext: Whoever recites the last two verses of Al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.

title: Gratitude Upon Waking in Health
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi afani fi jasadi, wa radda alayya ruhi, wa adhina li bidhikrih.
translation: All praise is for Allah who restored to me my health, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.
virtueOrContext: Recited upon waking to thank Allah for safety, life, and remembrance.

title: Dua for Sleep Restfulness
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ
transliteration: Allahumma Rabbas-samawati wa Rabbal-ardi wa Rabbal-arshil-azim, Rabbana wa Rabba kulli shay, faliqal-habbi wan-nawa, audhu bika min sharri kulli shayin anta akhidhun binasiyatih.
translation: O Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Mighty Throne. Our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date-stone, I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything whose forelock You hold.
virtueOrContext: Also removes anxiety about debt and spiritual poverty when recited at bedtime.

title: Tasbih Fatimah Before Sleep
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (٣٣) ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣) ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤)
transliteration: Subhanallah (33), Alhamdulillah (33), Allahu Akbar (34).
translation: Glory be to Allah (33 times), All praise is for Allah (33 times), Allah is the Greatest (34 times).
virtueOrContext: Taught by the Prophet to Fatimah and Ali as better than having a household helper.

title: Ruqyah with Surah Al-Fatihah
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۝ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
transliteration: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil-alamin. Ar-Rahmanir-Rahim. Maliki yawmid-din...
translation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds. The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Sovereign of the Day of Recompense...
virtueOrContext: The greatest Surah of the Quran and the primary Ruqyah for spiritual and physical healing.

title: Asking the Lord of Mankind for Complete Cure
arabicText: أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
transliteration: Adhhibil-basa Rabban-nas, washfi antash-Shafi, la shifaa illa shifauk, shifaan la yughadiru saqama.
translation: Remove the affliction, O Lord of mankind, and heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves behind no illness.
virtueOrContext: The Prophet would pass his right hand over the unwell person and recite this.

title: Jibril's Ruqyah Against Evil Eye and Harm
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ، مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنِ حَاسِدٍ، اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ
transliteration: Bismillahi arqik, min kulli shayin yudhik, min sharri kulli nafsin aw ayni hasid, Allahu yashfik, bismillahi arqik.
translation: In the name of Allah I perform Ruqyah for you, from everything that harms you, from the evil of every soul or envious eye. May Allah heal you; in the name of Allah I perform Ruqyah for you.
virtueOrContext: Recited by Angel Jibril over the Prophet during illness.

title: Ruqyah Placing Hand on Body Pain
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (ثَلَاثًا) ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ (سَبْعًا)
transliteration: Bismillah (3 times). Audhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir (7 times).
translation: In the name of Allah (three times). I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I find and fear (seven times).
virtueOrContext: Place your hand directly over the area of pain and recite as instructed by the Prophet.

title: Visiting the Sick for Sevenfold Recovery
arabicText: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
transliteration: Asalullahal-Azima Rabbal-Arshil-Azimi an yashfiyak.
translation: I ask Allah the Almighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal you.
virtueOrContext: Whoever visits a sick person not yet at death's door and says this seven times will be granted healing for them.

title: Surah Al-Ikhlas for Spiritual Protection
arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
transliteration: Qul huwallahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad.
translation: Say, He is Allah, Who is One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent.
virtueOrContext: Recite three times morning, evening, and before sleeping along with Al-Falaq and An-Nas.

title: Surah Al-Falaq Against Envy and Magic
arabicText: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
transliteration: Qul audhu birabbil-falaq, min sharri ma khalaq, wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab, wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-uqad, wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of that which He created, and from the evil of darkness when it settles, and from the evil of the blowers in knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.
virtueOrContext: One of the two Muawwidhatain revealed specifically for seeking refuge from magic and envy.

title: Surah An-Nas Against Satanic Whispers
arabicText: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ
transliteration: Qul audhu birabbin-nas, malikin-nas, ilahin-nas, min sharril-waswasil-khannas...
translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer...
virtueOrContext: Protects the heart from intrusive whispers and spiritual anxiety.

title: Ruqyah for Children and Family
arabicText: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
transliteration: Uidhukuma bikalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli aynin lammah.
translation: I seek refuge for you both in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous creature, and from every harmful evil eye.
virtueOrContext: The Prophet used to protect Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn with these words.

title: Soothing Comfort for One Who Is Ill
arabicText: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
transliteration: La basa tahurun in sha Allah.
translation: No harm, it will be a purification (from sins), if Allah wills.
virtueOrContext: Said to comfort a sick believer upon visiting them.

title: Ruqyah Against Fever and Heat
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الْكَبِيرِ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ عِرْقٍ نَعَّارٍ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَرِّ النَّارِ
transliteration: Bismillahil-Kabir, audhu billahil-Azim min sharri kulli irqin naar, wa min sharri harrin-nar.
translation: In the name of Allah the Great, I seek refuge in Allah the Almighty from the evil of every throbbing vein and from the evil of the heat of the Fire.
virtueOrContext: Taught by the Prophet for soothing fever and throbbing pain.

title: Quranic Verse of Spiritual Healing
arabicText: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa nunazzilu minal-Qurani ma huwa shifaun wa rahmatul-lil-muminin.
translation: And We send down of the Quran that which is healing and mercy for the believers.
virtueOrContext: Affirms that the Quran itself is a source of mercy and healing.

title: Prophet Ayyub's Prayer During Illness
arabicText: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
transliteration: Anni massaniyad-durru wa anta Arhamur-Rahimin.
translation: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
virtueOrContext: Prophet Ayyub called upon his Lord with this humble plea and Allah cured him completely.

title: Opening Supplication of Prayer (Istiftah)
arabicText: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
transliteration: Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabarakasmuka, wa taala jadduka, wa la ilaha ghayruk.
translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. Blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no deity worthy of worship besides You.
virtueOrContext: Recited silently after Takbiratul Ihram before Surah Al-Fatihah.

title: Seeking Forgiveness Between Prostrations
arabicText: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
transliteration: Rabbigh-fir li, Rabbigh-fir li.
translation: My Lord, forgive me. My Lord, forgive me.
virtueOrContext: Recited while sitting briefly between the two sujood (prostrations).

title: Supplication in Rukoo and Sujood
arabicText: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
transliteration: Subhanakallahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahummagh-fir li.
translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise be to You. O Allah, forgive me.
virtueOrContext: Frequently recited by the Prophet in bowing and prostration.

title: Seeking Refuge Before Concluding Salah
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni audhu bika min adhabi jahannama, wa min adhabil-qabri, wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamati, wa min sharri fitnatil-Masihid-Dajjal.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hellfire, from the punishment of the grave, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil trial of the False Messiah.
virtueOrContext: Commanded by the Prophet after completing Tashahhud and Durood before Tasleem.

title: Asking Allah's Help in Worship and Gratitude
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma ainni ala dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa husni ibadatik.
translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to give thanks to You, and to worship You in the best manner.
virtueOrContext: Taught directly by the Prophet to Muadh ibn Jabal to recite at the end of every Salah.

title: Dua Immediately After Tasleem
arabicText: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (ثَلَاثًا) ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
transliteration: Astaghfirullah (3 times). Allahumma antas-Salamu wa minkas-salamu, tabarakta ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram.
translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah (three times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace; blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.
virtueOrContext: Sunnah remembrance immediately after ending every obligatory prayer.

title: Dua When Entering the Mosque
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahummaf-tah li abwaba rahmatik.
translation: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
virtueOrContext: Recited while stepping into the mosque with the right foot.

title: Dua When Leaving the Mosque
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni asaluka min fadlik.
translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.
virtueOrContext: Recited when stepping out of the mosque with the left foot.

title: Dua After Hearing the Adhan
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
transliteration: Allahumma Rabba hadhihid-dawatit-tammah, was-salatil-qaimah, ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilah, wabathhu maqaman mahmudanil-ladhi waadtah.
translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the station of nearness and excellence, and raise him to the praised station that You have promised him.
virtueOrContext: Whoever recites this after the Adhan receives the Prophet's intercession on the Day of Judgment.

title: Dua for Steadfastness of Heart
arabicText: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
transliteration: Ya Muqallibal-qulubi thabbit qalbi ala dinik.
translation: O Turner of the hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.
virtueOrContext: The most frequent supplication of the Prophet.

title: Dua After Completing Wudu (Ablution)
arabicText: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh.
translation: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
virtueOrContext: All eight gates of Paradise are opened for the one who performs Wudu well and recites this.

title: Qunoot of Witr Prayer
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ
transliteration: Allahummah-dini fiman hadayt, wa afini fiman afayt, wa tawallani fiman tawallayt, wa barik li fima atayt, wa qini sharra ma qadayt.
translation: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being, take me into Your care among those You have cared for, bless me in what You have given, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed.
virtueOrContext: Taught by the Prophet to Al-Hasan ibn Ali for Witr prayer.

title: Istikharah Dua (Seeking Guidance in Decisions)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka biilmika, wa astaqdiruka biqudratika, wa asaluka min fadlikal-azim, fa innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa talamu wa la alam, wa anta Allamul-ghuyub.
translation: O Allah, I seek Your counsel through Your knowledge, I seek power through Your might, and I ask You from Your immense bounty. For You have power and I do not, You know and I do not, and You are the Knower of the unseen.
virtueOrContext: Recited after two voluntary Rakaat when making any important life decision.

title: Great Dua for Lifting Grief and Sorrow
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي
transliteration: Allahumma inni abduka, ibnu abdika, ibnu amatika, nasiyati biyadika, madin fiyya hukmuka, adlun fiyya qadauka, asaluka bikullis-min huwa laka an tajalal-Qurana rabia qalbi.
translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand, Your command over me is forever executed, and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You to make the Quran the spring of my heart.
virtueOrContext: Allah removes sorrow and anxiety from whoever recites this sincerely and replaces it with joy.

title: Dua of Prophet Yunus in Deep Distress
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
virtueOrContext: No Muslim calls upon Allah with these words regarding any matter except that Allah responds.

title: Prophetic Refuge from Anxiety and Helplessness
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni audhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dalaid-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts, and being overpowered by people.
virtueOrContext: A comprehensive daily shield against emotional distress, lethargy, and financial pressure.

title: Relief at Moments of Severe Distress
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-Azimul-Halim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbul-Arshil-Azim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-Arshil-Karim.
translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
virtueOrContext: Words of comfort spoken by the Prophet whenever facing hardship.

title: Turning Every Difficult Task Easy
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma jaaltahu sahla, wa anta tajalul-hazna idha shita sahla.
translation: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy.
virtueOrContext: Recited when facing tough exams, responsibilities, or obstacles.

title: Hoping Only for Allah's Mercy
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arju fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn, wa aslih li shani kullahu, la ilaha illa anta.
translation: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for the blink of an eye, and rectify for me all of my affairs. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
virtueOrContext: Prophetic supplication for someone experiencing anguish or worry.

title: Calling Upon the Ever-Living Sustainer
arabicText: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum birahmatika astaghith, aslih li shani kullahu wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn.
translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all existence, in Your mercy I seek relief. Rectify all of my affairs and do not entrust me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
virtueOrContext: The Prophet used to call upon Allah with these words whenever hardship struck.

title: Trusting Allah When Fearful or Threatened
arabicText: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa nimal-wakil.
translation: Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
virtueOrContext: Spoken by Prophet Ibrahim when cast into the fire and by Prophet Muhammad when facing opposition.

title: Words at Times of Loss or Calamity
arabicText: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi rajiun, Allahumma jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha.
translation: Indeed we belong to Allah and indeed to Him we shall return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with something better.
virtueOrContext: Allah compensates the believer with something better whenever recited during misfortune.

title: Subduing Anger and Frustration
arabicText: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
transliteration: Audhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.
virtueOrContext: Prescribed by the Prophet as the immediate remedy when overcome by anger.

title: Prophet Musa's Dua for Ease and Clarity
arabicText: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي ۝ وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي ۝ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي ۝ يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
transliteration: Rabbish-rah li sadri, wa yassir li amri, wahlul uqdatan min lisani, yafqahu qawli.
translation: My Lord, expand for me my chest, ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.
virtueOrContext: Supplication for confidence, emotional openness, and clarity of speech.

title: Submitting to Allah's Will Without Regret
arabicText: قَدَرُ اللَّهِ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
transliteration: Qadarullahi wa ma shaa faal.
translation: It is the decree of Allah, and what He wills, He does.
virtueOrContext: Prevents regret and opens peace of mind after an unexpected setback.

title: Seeking Help in Allah's Power
arabicText: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
translation: There is no change of state nor power except through Allah.
virtueOrContext: Described by the Prophet as one of the treasures of Paradise.

title: Prophetic Sitting Repentance
arabicText: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbigh-fir li wa tub alayya innaka antat-Tawwabur-Rahim.
translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance; indeed You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
virtueOrContext: The Prophet would say this one hundred times in a single gathering.

title: Comprehensive Istighfar
arabicText: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
transliteration: Astaghfirullahal-Azimal-ladhi la ilaha illa huwal-Hayyul-Qayyumu wa atubu ilayh.
translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Almighty, besides whom there is no deity, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent unto Him.
virtueOrContext: A profound formula of repentance seeking Allah's complete pardon.

title: Dua for Pardoning Sin (Laylatul Qadr)
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
transliteration: Allahumma innaka Afuwwun tuhibbul-afwa fafu anni.
translation: O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning and You love pardon, so pardon me.
virtueOrContext: Taught to Aishah specifically for Laylatul Qadr and blessed nights.

title: Confessing Excess and Seeking Forgiveness
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta, faghfir li maghfiratan min indika warhamni innaka antal-Ghafurur-Rahim.
translation: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly, and none forgives sins except You. So grant me forgiveness from You and have mercy upon me, for You are the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
virtueOrContext: Taught by the Prophet to Abu Bakr as-Siddiq to recite inside Salah.

title: Washing Sins Away Like Water and Snow
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ
transliteration: Allahumma baid bayni wa bayna khatayaya kama baadta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib, Allahumma naqqini minal-khataya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas.
translation: O Allah, distance me from my sins just as You have distanced the East from the West. O Allah, purify me from sins as a white garment is cleansed of stains.
virtueOrContext: Recited in the opening of prayer for deep purification of the soul.

title: Dua of Adam and Hawwa for Repentance
arabicText: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin.
translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
virtueOrContext: The first supplication of repentance on earth, accepted immediately by Allah.

title: Forgiveness for Errors Known and Unknown
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي، وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي
transliteration: Allahummagh-fir li khatiati wa jahli, wa israfi fi amri, wa ma anta alamu bihi minni.
translation: O Allah, forgive me my mistakes, my ignorance, my excess in my affairs, and whatever You know better about me than I do.
virtueOrContext: Covers both intentional and unintentional shortcomings.

title: Plea for Complete Pardon and Guidance
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي
transliteration: Allahummagh-fir li, warhamni, wahdini, wa afini, warzuqni.
translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, grant me well-being, and provide for me.
virtueOrContext: The Prophet stated that these five requests encompass the good of this world and the Hereafter.

title: Kaffarat al-Majlis (Expiation of a Gathering)
arabicText: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
transliteration: Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika, ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk.
translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You; I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
virtueOrContext: Recited when concluding any gathering or conversation to expiate idle speech.

title: Dua While Prostrating for Full Forgiveness
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
transliteration: Allahummagh-fir li dhanbi kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa akhirahu, wa alaniyatahu wa sirrah.
translation: O Allah, forgive me all of my sins: the small and the great, the first and the last, the open and the secret.
virtueOrContext: Recited by the Prophet while in prostration (sujood).

title: Asking for a Pure and Humble Heart
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا، وَزَكِّهَا أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا، أَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلَاهَا
transliteration: Allahumma ati nafsi taqwaha, wa zakkiha anta khayru man zakkaha, anta waliyyuha wa mawlaha.
translation: O Allah, grant my soul its piety and purify it, for You are the Best of those who purify it. You are its Guardian and Master.
virtueOrContext: Plea for spiritual purity and protection against inner arrogance.

title: Pardon for the Believing Community
arabicText: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا
transliteration: Rabbanagh-fir lana wa li-ikhwaninal-ladhina sabaquna bil-iman, wa la tajal fi qulubina ghillal-lilladhina amanu.
translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and put not in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed.
virtueOrContext: Purifies the heart from jealousy and seeks mercy for all believers.

title: Prophet Musa's Repentance After a Slip
arabicText: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي
transliteration: Rabbi inni zalamtu nafsi faghfir li.
translation: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me.
virtueOrContext: Concise Quranic supplication for immediate repentance.

title: Dua When Stepping Out of the Home
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah; there is no might nor power except through Allah.
virtueOrContext: An angel announces that the person is guided, protected, and defended, and Satan turns away.

title: Dua When Entering the Home
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa alallahi Rabbina tawakkalna.
translation: In the name of Allah we enter, and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we rely.
virtueOrContext: Recited before greeting one's household with Salam upon returning home.

title: Dua for Boarding a Vehicle or Starting a Journey
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun.
translation: Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have controlled it ourselves, and indeed to our Lord we will return.
virtueOrContext: Recited when sitting in any vehicle, train, or airplane for a safe journey.

title: Full Travel Supplication
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ
transliteration: Allahumma inna nasaluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-amali ma tarda, Allahumma hawwin alayna safarana hadha watwi anna budah.
translation: O Allah, we ask You in this journey of ours for righteousness, piety, and deeds pleasing to You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance for us.
virtueOrContext: Includes seeking protection for one's family left behind and safe return home.

title: Returning Home Safely from Travel
arabicText: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
transliteration: Ayibuna taibuna abiduna li-Rabbina hamidun.
translation: We return homeward, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.
virtueOrContext: Spoken by the Prophet whenever returning from travel.

title: Before Eating and Drinking
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فَلْيَقُلْ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
transliteration: Bismillah. (If forgotten at first): Bismillahi fi awwalihi wa akhirih.
translation: In the name of Allah. (If forgotten at first): In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end.
virtueOrContext: Brings blessing into the meal and keeps Satan away from sharing it.

title: After Finishing a Meal
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi atamani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.
virtueOrContext: Past minor sins are forgiven for the one who sincerely praises Allah after eating.

title: Dua for a Generous Host After Eating
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
transliteration: Allahumma barik lahum fima razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum.
translation: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided for them, forgive them, and have mercy upon them.
virtueOrContext: Recited for the host after dining at someone's home.

title: Dua When Putting on New Clothing
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtanihi, asaluka min khayrihi wa khayri ma sunia lah, wa audhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma sunia lah.
translation: O Allah, all praise belongs to You, You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.
virtueOrContext: Expresses gratitude whenever wearing new clothes.

title: Dua Before Entering the Restroom
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
transliteration: Bismillah, Allahumma inni audhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khabaith.
translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female evil spirits.
virtueOrContext: Recited quietly before stepping inside.

title: Dua Upon Leaving the Restroom
arabicText: غُفْرَانَكَ
transliteration: Ghufranak.
translation: I seek Your forgiveness.
virtueOrContext: Recited upon stepping out with the right foot.

title: Dua When Entering a Market or Shopping Center
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa Hayyun la yamut, biyadihil-khayru wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir.
translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone without partner; to Him belongs dominion and praise. He gives life and causes death while He is Ever-Living and never dies. In His hand is all goodness, and He is over all things capable.
virtueOrContext: Remembers Allah amid worldly commerce and distraction.

title: Dua When Breaking the Fast (Iftar)
arabicText: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
transliteration: Dhahabaz-zamau wabtallatil-uruqu, wa thabatal-ajru in sha Allah.
translation: Thirst has vanished, the veins have been moistened, and the reward is assured, if Allah wills.
virtueOrContext: Spoken immediately upon breaking a fast with dates or water.

title: Quranic Dua for Comfort in Spouse and Children
arabicText: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata ayunin wajalna lil-muttaqina imama.
translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader for the righteous.
virtueOrContext: Characteristic supplication of the faithful servants of the Most Merciful.

title: Dua for Loving Mercy Toward Parents
arabicText: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
transliteration: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira.
translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them both just as they raised me when I was small.
virtueOrContext: Commanded by Allah as an act of dutifulness to parents living or deceased.

title: Prophet Ibrahim's Dua for Prayerful Descendants
arabicText: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
transliteration: Rabbijalni muqimas-salati wa min dhurriyyati, Rabbana wa taqabbal dua.
translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and many from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
virtueOrContext: Ensures a legacy of devotion and regular Salah across generations.

title: Prophet Zakariyya's Dua for Pure Offspring
arabicText: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibatan innaka Samiud-dua.
translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.
virtueOrContext: Heartfelt plea for pious, blessed children.

title: Blessing Newlyweds on Their Marriage
arabicText: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
transliteration: Barakallahu lak, wa baraka alayk, wa jamaa baynakuma fi khayr.
translation: May Allah bless you, shower His blessings upon you, and unite both of you in goodness.
virtueOrContext: Sunnah greeting for newly married couples.

title: Prayer for Righteous Children at Age Forty
arabicText: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي
transliteration: Rabbi awzini an ashkura nimatakal-lati anamta alayya wa ala walidayya wa an amala salihan tardahu wa aslih li fi dhurriyyati.
translation: My Lord, inspire me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do righteousness of which You approve, and make righteous for me my offspring.
virtueOrContext: Combines gratitude for parents with a prayer for the righteousness of one's children.

title: Prayer for Parents and All Believers
arabicText: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
transliteration: Rabbanagh-fir li wa li-walidayya wa lil-muminina yawma yaqumul-hisab.
translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
virtueOrContext: Supplication of Prophet Ibrahim on behalf of parents and the Muslim Ummah.

title: Congratulating Parents on a Newborn Child
arabicText: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ
transliteration: Barakallahu laka fil-mawhubi lak, wa shakartal-wahib, wa balagha ashuddahu, wa ruziqta birrah.
translation: May Allah bless you with His gift to you, may you give thanks to the Giver, may the child reach full maturity, and may you be blessed with their righteousness.
virtueOrContext: Traditional Islamic blessing shared with parents welcoming a newborn.

title: Protecting Family Before Intimacy
arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
transliteration: Bismillah, Allahumma jannibnash-shaytana, wa jannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana.
translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from whatever offspring You may bless us with.
virtueOrContext: If a child is conceived at that time, Satan will never be able to harm them.

title: Asking Allah Not to Leave One Lonely
arabicText: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi la tadharni fardan wa anta khayrul-warithin.
translation: My Lord, do not leave me alone without an heir, while You are the best of inheritors.
virtueOrContext: Dua of Prophet Zakariyya when hoping for righteous family and children.

title: Asking for a Righteous Helper in Family or Mission
arabicText: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi hab li minas-salihin.
translation: My Lord, grant me a child from among the righteous.
virtueOrContext: Prophet Ibrahim's brief yet deeply answered prayer.

title: Supplicating for Deceased Parents or Loved Ones
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ
transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lahu warhamhu, wa afihi wafu anhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi mudkhalah.
translation: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy upon him, keep him safe and pardon him, make his reception honorable, and expand his resting place.
virtueOrContext: Prophetic funeral and grave-visitation supplication for deceased loved ones.

title: Blessing the Host and Family Provision
arabicText: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
transliteration: Aftara indakumus-saimun, wa akala taamakumul-abrar, wa sallat alaykumul-malaikah.
translation: May the fasting break their fast with you, may the righteous eat your food, and may the angels send blessings upon you.
virtueOrContext: Recited for families who host Iftar or meals.

title: Seeking Protection From All Directions
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
transliteration: Allahummah-fazni min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfi, wa an yamini, wa an shimali, wa min fawqi, wa audhu biazamatika an ughtala min tahti.
translation: O Allah, guard me from in front of me, from behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being harmed from beneath me.
virtueOrContext: Recited morning and evening for complete 360-degree divine protection.

title: Refuge From the Evil of One's Own Soul
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
transliteration: Allahumma Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, Rabba kulli shayin wa malikah, audhu bika min sharri nafsi wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih.
translation: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Lord and Sovereign of everything, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul and from the evil of Satan and his call to polytheism.
virtueOrContext: Taught to Abu Bakr to say morning, evening, and upon going to bed.

title: Refuge From Losing Blessings and Sudden Wrath
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni audhu bika min zawali nimatik, wa tahawwuli afiyatik, wa fujaati niqmatik, wa jamii sakhatik.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the decline of Your blessings, the reversal of Your well-being, Your sudden punishment, and all of Your displeasure.
virtueOrContext: Safeguards sustained health, faith, and blessings.

title: Refuge From Bad Manners and Diseases
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ، وَالْجُنُونِ، وَالْجُذَامِ، وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni audhu bika minal-barasi, wal-jununi, wal-judhami, wa min sayyiil-asqam.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leprosy, madness, elephantiasis, and from all severe, incurable diseases.
virtueOrContext: Authentic Prophetic shield against severe chronic illnesses.

title: Shield Against Four Unbeneficial Things
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ، وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ، وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
transliteration: Allahumma inni audhu bika min ilmin la yanfa, wa min qalbin la yakhsha, wa min nafsin la tashba, wa min dawatin la yustajabu laha.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that does not humble itself, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered.
virtueOrContext: Protects the sincerity of knowledge, worship, and inner contentment.

title: Refuge From Whisperings of Devils
arabicText: رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ ۝ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
transliteration: Rabbi audhu bika min hamazatish-shayatin, wa audhu bika Rabbi an yahdurun.
translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.
virtueOrContext: Quranic instruction for repelling evil impulses and whispers.

title: Seeking Refuge When Thunder Strikes
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi yusabbihur-radu bihamdihi wal-malaikatu min khifatih.
translation: Glory be to Him whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels out of awe of Him.
virtueOrContext: Recited by Abdullah ibn az-Zubayr whenever he heard thunder.

title: Dua During Strong Winds and Storms
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni asaluka khayraha, wa khayra ma fiha, wa khayra ma ursilat bih, wa audhu bika min sharriha, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma ursilat bih.
translation: O Allah, I ask You for its goodness, the good within it, and the good with which it was sent; and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil within it, and the evil with which it was sent.
virtueOrContext: Recited when strong winds blow.

title: Dua When Seeing Beneficial Rain
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafia.
translation: O Allah, make it a beneficial downpour.
virtueOrContext: A time when supplications are readily accepted by Allah.

title: Dua When Hearing a Rooster or Donkey at Night
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni asaluka min fadlik.
translation: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.
virtueOrContext: When hearing a rooster crow, ask Allah for His bounty; when hearing a donkey bray, seek refuge from Satan.

title: Seeking Refuge From Oppressive Enemies
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
transliteration: Allahumma inna najaluka fi nuhurihim wa naudhu bika min shururihim.
translation: O Allah, we place You before them and seek refuge in You from their evil.
virtueOrContext: Recited when fearing harm from hostile individuals or oppressors.

title: Dua When Greeting the New Crescent Moon
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
transliteration: Allahumma ahillahu alayna bil-yumni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-Islam, Rabbi wa Rabbukallah.
translation: O Allah, let this moon appear upon us with blessing and faith, safety and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.
virtueOrContext: Recited at the start of every Islamic lunar month.

title: Dua Against Hypocrisy and Bad Character
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشِّقَاقِ وَالنِّفَاقِ وَسُوءِ الْأَخْلَاقِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni audhu bika minash-shiqaqi wan-nifaqi wa suil-akhlaq.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from divisiveness, hypocrisy, and evil character.
virtueOrContext: Safeguards integrity of speech, conduct, and social harmony.

title: Suffering Debt: Lawful Provision Over Unlawful
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
transliteration: Allahummak-fini bihalalika an haramika, wa aghnini bifadlika amman siwak.
translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful over what You have made unlawful, and enrich me by Your bounty so that I have no need of anyone besides You.
virtueOrContext: Taught by Ali ibn Abi Talib from the Prophet to pay off even a mountain-sized debt.

title: Refuge From Disbelief and Poverty
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni audhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa audhu bika min adhabil-qabr.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave.
virtueOrContext: Recited three times morning and evening.

title: Prophet Musa's Prayer in Need
arabicText: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir.
translation: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
virtueOrContext: Soon after saying this, Prophet Musa received shelter, livelihood, and marriage.

title: Asking for Guidance, Piety, and Self-Sufficiency
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى، وَالتُّقَى، وَالْعَفَافَ، وَالْغِنَى
transliteration: Allahumma inni asalukal-huda, wat-tuqa, wal-afafa, wal-ghina.
translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and contentment.
virtueOrContext: Asks for both spiritual wealth of the heart and financial independence.

title: Asking Allah for Abundance and Blessing
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنِي، وَاغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي
transliteration: Allahumma barik li fima razaqtani, waghfir li, warhamni.
translation: O Allah, bless me in what You have provided for me, forgive me, and have mercy on me.
virtueOrContext: Barakah turns even modest earnings into abundant peace and sufficiency.

title: Seeking Relief from Hunger and Treachery
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُوعِ فَإِنَّهُ بِئْسَ الضَّجِيعُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخِيَانَةِ فَإِنَّهَا بِئْسَتِ الْبِطَانَةُ
transliteration: Allahumma inni audhu bika minal-jui fa innahu bisad-daji, wa audhu bika minal-khiyanati fa innaha bisatil-bitanah.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from hunger, for it is an evil companion, and I seek refuge in You from treachery, for it is an evil inner trait.
virtueOrContext: Guards livelihood alongside honesty in business and trust.

title: Dua for Increase in Knowledge and Wisdom
arabicText: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
transliteration: Rabbi zidni ilma.
translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
virtueOrContext: The only thing Allah directly commanded His Messenger to ask for an increase of.

title: Asking for a Clear Opening and Victory
arabicText: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaf-tah baynana wa bayna qawmina bil-haqqi wa anta khayrul-fatihin.
translation: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision.
virtueOrContext: Recited when seeking lawful breakthroughs and justice in work or life.

title: Seeking Blessing in Early Morning Work
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِأُمَّتِي فِي بُكُورِهَا
transliteration: Allahumma barik li-ummati fi bukuriha.
translation: O Allah, bless my Ummah in its early mornings.
virtueOrContext: Encourages beginning work, study, and trade early in the morning.

title: Dua of Prophet Sulayman for Kingdom and Grace
arabicText: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَا يَنْبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِي ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
transliteration: Rabbigh-fir li wa hab li mulkan la yanbaghi li-ahadin min badi, innaka antal-Wahhab.
translation: My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
virtueOrContext: Shows pairing forgiveness with ambitious lawful requests from Al-Wahhab.

title: Blessing the Wealth and Family of a Benefactor
arabicText: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
transliteration: Jazakallahu khayra.
translation: May Allah reward you with goodness.
virtueOrContext: Whoever says this to someone who did them good has excelled in thanking them.

title: Dua for Relief of Debt at Bedtime
arabicText: اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
transliteration: Aqdi annad-dayna wa aghnina minal-faqr.
translation: Settle our debts for us and enrich us beyond poverty.
virtueOrContext: Closing plea of the comprehensive bedtime supplication taught to Fatimah.

title: Acknowledging Allah as Provider Alone
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
transliteration: Allahumma la mania lima atayt, wa la mutiya lima manat, wa la yanfau dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.
translation: O Allah, none can withhold what You have given, and none can give what You have withheld, nor can wealth or fortune benefit anyone against Your will.
virtueOrContext: Recited after every obligatory Salah to anchor reliance solely on Allah.

title: Praise Worthy of Allah's Majesty
arabicText: يَا رَبِّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِجَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ وَلِعَظِيمِ سُلْطَانِكَ
transliteration: Ya Rabbi lakal-hamdu kama yanbaghi lijalali wajhika wa liazimi sultanik.
translation: O my Lord, all praise is due to You as befits the Majesty of Your Countenance and the Greatness of Your Sovereignty.
virtueOrContext: Words of immense gratitude reflecting awe of Allah's greatness.

title: Two Light Words Heavy on the Scale
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, Subhanallahil-Azim.
translation: Glory be to Allah and praise Him; Glory be to Allah the Almighty.
virtueOrContext: Light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale of deeds, and beloved to the Most Merciful.

title: The Four Most Beloved Phrases to Allah
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
transliteration: Subhanallah, walhamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar.
translation: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
virtueOrContext: The most beloved speech to Allah, no matter which one you begin with.

title: Daily 100x Praise for Erasing Sins
arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih.
translation: Glory be to Allah and praise Him.
virtueOrContext: Whoever says this 100 times in a day has their sins forgiven even if like the foam of the sea.

title: Best Dhikr and Best Supplication
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
transliteration: La ilaha illallah, walhamdulillah.
translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and all praise is for Allah.
virtueOrContext: The best remembrance is La ilaha illallah, and the best supplication is Alhamdulillah.

title: Gratitude Upon Receiving Joyful News
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi binimatihi tatimmus-salihat.
translation: All praise is for Allah by whose favor good things are perfected.
virtueOrContext: Said by the Prophet whenever something pleasing occurred.

title: Gratitude in Challenging Times
arabicText: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi ala kulli hal.
translation: All praise is for Allah in every circumstance.
virtueOrContext: Said by the Prophet even when facing unpleasant or difficult situations.

title: Prophet Sulayman's Prayer of Gratitude
arabicText: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ
transliteration: Rabbi awzini an ashkura nimatakal-lati anamta alayya wa ala walidayya wa an amala salihan tardah.
translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve.
virtueOrContext: Spoken by Prophet Sulayman in humility and gratitude for Allah's gifts.

title: Morning Praise Equal to Freeing Ten Slaves
arabicText: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir.
translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone without partner; to Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things capable.
virtueOrContext: Reciting 100 times daily yields 100 good deeds, erases 100 sins, and protects from Satan.

title: Morning and Evening Gratitude for Blessings
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
transliteration: Allahumma ma asbaha bi min nimatin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika faminka wahdaka la sharika lak, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr.
translation: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have entered the morning with is from You alone without partner, so for You is all praise and unto You all thanks.
virtueOrContext: Whoever says this morning and evening has fulfilled their gratitude for the day and night.

title: Sending Peace and Blessings on the Prophet
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammadin kama sallayta ala Ibrahima wa ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidum-Majid.
translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.
virtueOrContext: Whoever sends one blessing upon the Prophet, Allah sends ten blessings upon them.

title: Filling the Heavens and Earth With Praise
arabicText: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
transliteration: Rabbana wa lakal-hamdu hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih.
translation: Our Lord, and to You belongs all praise: abundant, pure, and blessed praise.
virtueOrContext: Over thirty angels raced to record this phrase when a Companion said it after rising from Rukoo.

title: Gratitude When Looking in the Mirror
arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِي فَأَحْسِنْ خُلُقِي
transliteration: Allahumma ahsanta khalqi fa ahsin khuluqi.
translation: O Allah, just as You have made my outward form good, make my character good as well.
virtueOrContext: Connects physical appreciation with a prayer for noble manners.

title: Rabbana Atina fid-Dunya Hasanah
arabicText: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhaban-nar.
translation: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
virtueOrContext: The most comprehensive and most frequent supplication of the Prophet.

title: Rabbana La Tuzigh Qulubana
arabicText: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana bada idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-Wahhab.
translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
virtueOrContext: Supplication of those firmly grounded in knowledge for steadfast guidance.

title: Rabbana Afrigh Alayna Sabra
arabicText: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana afrigh alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna alal-qawmil-kafirin.
translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
virtueOrContext: Recited for courage, patience, and steadfastness during overwhelming challenges.

title: Rabbana La Tuakhidhna
arabicText: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا
transliteration: Rabbana la tuakhidhna in nasina aw akhtana, Rabbana wa la tahmil alayna isran kama hamaltahu alal-ladhina min qablina.
translation: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us.
virtueOrContext: Allah answered this supplication directly with 'Yes, I have done so.' (Sahih Muslim 126).

title: Rabbana Taqabbal Minna
arabicText: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka antas-Samiul-Alim.
translation: Our Lord, accept this from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
virtueOrContext: Recited by Ibrahim and Ismail while raising the foundations of the Kabah.

title: Rabbana Innana Amanna Faghfir Lana
arabicText: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana innana amanna faghfir lana dhunubana wa qina adhaban-nar.
translation: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
virtueOrContext: Humble plea uniting faith with repentance.

title: Rabbana Faghfir Lana Dhunubana
arabicText: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
transliteration: Rabbana faghfir lana dhunubana wa kaffir anna sayyiatina wa tawaffana maal-abrar.
translation: Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.
virtueOrContext: Supplication of the people of understanding reflecting on creation.

title: Rabbana Atina Min Ladunka Rahmah
arabicText: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi lana min amrina rashada.
translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
virtueOrContext: Dua of the Companions of the Cave when seeking divine mercy and direction.

title: Rabbana Wasrif Anna Adhaba Jahannam
arabicText: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
transliteration: Rabbanas-rif anna adhaba jahannama inna adhabaha kana gharama.
translation: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering.
virtueOrContext: Plea of the humble worshippers in the night prayer.

title: Rabbana Alayka Tawakkalna
arabicText: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
transliteration: Rabbana alayka tawakkalna wa ilayka anabna wa ilaykal-masir.
translation: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.
virtueOrContext: Affirmation of complete trust in Allah taught through Prophet Ibrahim.

title: Rabbana Atmimlana Nurana
arabicText: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: Rabbana atmim lana nurana waghfir lana innaka ala kulli shayin qadir.
translation: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
virtueOrContext: Supplication of the believers for eternal light on the Day of Resurrection.

title: Rabbana Amanna Faktubna Maash-Shahidin
arabicText: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana amanna faktubna maash-shahidin.
translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses.
virtueOrContext: Expression of humble faith upon hearing the Quran.

title: Rabbana La Tajalna Fitnatan
arabicText: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ ۝ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana la tajalna fitnatal-lil-qawmiz-zalimin, wa najjina birahmatika minal-qawmil-kafirin.
translation: Our Lord, make us not an object of trial for the wrongdoing people, and save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
virtueOrContext: Dua of believers seeking safety from oppression and religious trial.
